svg.aria-label: Left, the earlier repository: thousands of loose pieces, 100 percent matched one at a time, in 17,504 files, that make a working game only when forced. Right, this repository: the same pieces in their real files, 25.7 percent matched, 3,253 files, 366 of them already playing identically in the real game.
svg.text: The same pieces, in their real files
only when forced, with stand-in parts
assembled file by file, and tested
matched, but each piece only by itself
files, mostly one function in each
shortcuts and private class copies to undo
matched, and every point is finished source
files, the way the game was built
of them already play identically in the real game
